identity_features.pickscore: one raw scaled image/text cosine, no softmax across generators
identity_features.visual: 12 fixed values derived solely from normalized pixels
identity_features.pickscore_image_embedding: normalized image embedding from the same PickScore model; supplementary, not independent

text: Prompt is used by PickScore scalar; text embeddings are stored for score audit but never a standalone identity feature. All generators have identical prompt allocation.
missingness: No missingness indicator is a feature. Black/safety outputs excluded explicitly. No Nemotron vectors fabricated.
resolution: Judge/local images standardized to RGB 512 square. This does not remove native generation-resolution effects.
watermark: SDXL invisible watermarker explicitly disabled before generation. Standard SD1.x safety checks remain enabled. SDXL base distribution has no built-in safety checker.
